result.scope_note: The claim asserts that the majority of U.S. state high points have elevations above 1,000 feet according to the 2012 Statistical Abstract. Research indicates that the highest state high point is Denali at 20,310 feet, while the lowest high point is Britton Hill at 345 feet. Whether 'most' exceed 1,000 feet depends on the distribution of all 50 state high points, which would require verification against the specific dataset cited.
